classification.difficultyReason: The source requires inferring missing rectangle dimensions from composite figures, forming area expressions, expanding, and collecting like terms.

content.prompt: Find the area of these shapes in simplest expanded form.

spec.description: L-shaped outline with its taller section on the left and lower arm on the right. A red dashed horizontal partition joins the left edge to the re-entrant corner.
spec.mathematics: Total height 2x, right-arm height x, total width x+3, exposed upper edge of the right arm 2. The upper-left rectangle therefore has width x+1 and height x.
spec.answerVisibility: The question retains all four supplied labels and the partition; inferred dimensions and area calculations appear only in the answer.

answer.worked:
The upper rectangle has width $(x+3)-2=x+1$ and height $2x-x=x$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=x(x+3)+x(x+1)\\A&=x^2+3x+x^2+x\\A&=2x^2+4x\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unfilled composite outline with a tall right rectangle and a short extension projecting left from its top. A red dashed vertical partition joins the top edge to the re-entrant corner.
spec.mathematics: Total top width x+5, total right height x, exposed inner vertical length x-2, and left extension width 3. The right rectangle has width x+2 and the left extension has height 2.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied dimensions and the partition remain visible; inferred dimensions and area calculations are answer-only.

answer.worked:
The left extension has height $x-(x-2)=2$. The right rectangle has width $(x+5)-3=x+2$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=3(2)+x(x+2)\\A&=6+x^2+2x\end{align*}$$
